users:

    shell: "/bin/bash"
    sudo: "ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD:ALL"
    lock_passwd: true
    ssh_authorized_keys:
      - "ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAII09aAH4nB51WiDs/YSaWdGiOqdPtmkld5DSqBHCuko2 mov-mov-v46"
# Rendered by mov from the env's profile. The site is never uploaded from the
# workstation: the host clones it from GitHub, so the machine is reproducible
# from the repository alone.
package_update: true
package_upgrade: true
# Never here: a reboot owed by the upgrade is given by mov's verify stage,
# after the checks pass and before they run again.
package_reboot_if_required: false

packages:
  - git

write_files:
  - path: /etc/mov/deploy.env
    permissions: '0644'
    content: |
      MOV_ENV=v46
      MOV_REPO=82danass/aws
      MOV_REF=master
      MOV_PATH=v45
      MOV_APP_DIR=/opt/mov/app
      MOV_ENVIRONMENT_HERE=here

runcmd:
  - [ mkdir, -p, '/opt/mov/app' ]
  - [ git, clone, --depth, '1', --branch, 'master', 'https://github.com/82danass/aws.git', '/opt/mov/app' ]
  - [ bash, '/opt/mov/app/scripts/wordpress.sh' ]

final_message: "mov: v46 bootstrap finished"
